CONTRADICTIONS RESOLVED: (1) drivers/edac/versal_edac.c inject_data_ue_store - f015 is correct: line 854 declares 'char buf[6]', line 859 clamps 'len = min_t(size_t, count, sizeof(buf));' without -1, line 860 copies len bytes, line 863 writes 'buf[len] = \'\\0\'' at index 6 (== sizeof(buf)) whenever count >= 6 - a deterministic 1-byte NUL stack out-of-bounds WRITE from a debugfs write(2) ('inject_ue' file, 0200, xddr_inject_ue_fops); f005's 'safe' classification is wrong for this snapshot. (2) drivers/scsi/wd33c93.c:2019 - f005's PAGE_SIZE-boundary claim is false for s03: PROC_BLOCK_SIZE is (3*1024)=3072 (scsi_proc.c:42) and proc_scsi_host_write rejects count > 3072 before passing (PAGE_SIZE page, count) to ->write_info, so buf[len] at len<=3072 is in-bounds; imm.c/ppa.c write_info handlers perform no terminator write at all (their missing-termination parse issues belong to i012).

FINDINGS (2, high confidence, literal quotes in ranges): s03 drivers/edac/versal_edac.c:859-863 and s03 drivers/edac/zynqmp_edac.c:307-311, both quoting 'len = min_t(size_t, count, sizeof(buf)); / if (copy_from_user(buf, data, len)) / return -EFAULT; / buf[len] = \'\\0\'' on char buf[6] - the seed fix primitive (terminator slot) misapplied so the terminator write lands one byte past the 6-byte stack array; zynqmp's 'inject_ue_bitpos' debugfs file is mode 0644. No count > sizeof(buf)-1 rejection exists in either handler (contrast industrialio-core.c, intel/pmc/core.c, lib/kstrtox.c which all use -1 or >=-rejection).

SWEEP: tree-wide s03 inventory of terminator writes (buf[idx]=0/'\\0') co-located with usercopy (~120 sites) - every other site carries a concrete guard (count >= sizeof(buf) rejection, count > 15/39/63 rejection, sizeof(buf)-1 clamp, or simple_write_to_buffer with size-1): wd33c93, imm, ppa, srm_env, rtas-proc, lpar x2, acpi/proc, ath11k x6, mac80211 x4, mt76 x5, sched/debug x3, and the guard-matched families in smackfs, hisilicon, rtw89, toshiba, trace, i915, ath5k/ath6kl/ath9k, habanalabs, fnic/snic, cxgb4, xen-netback, ntb_tool, regmap-debugfs, vgaarb, netdevsim, pmc core, picolcd, wiimote, via-pmu, viafb, chipidea, iommu, user_namespace, sunrpc x2, kcsan, shrinker, dma/debug, kstrtox, spufs - classified safe in the candidates list.

LIMITATIONS: hypotheses from literal source structure; no in-kernel KASAN run in this read-only snapshot (the identical s02 pattern was ASan-verified by f015 as 'stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1'); sites with usercopy farther than 25 lines from the terminator write, hidden in helpers, or using pointer-form terminators (*p=0, buf[i++]=0 loops) were not exhaustively line-verified; both findings require the Xilinx EDAC driver loaded and debugfs access, and impact beyond one adjacent stack byte is not demonstrated.
